newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners continue to sell Japanese stocks in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners continue to sell Japanese stocks in Nov.

text.p: Foreign investors were net sellers of Japanese stocks for the second consecutive month in November, although the amount had decreased from October, an official at the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
Net selling of Japanese stocks by foreign investors totalled 14.3 billion yen in November, down from 70.3 billion yen in October, MOF said.
"In early November, foreign investors moved to take profits in small lots due to the higher yen," the MOF official told reporters.

Although blue chips with good earnings attracted buying from both domestic and foreign institutional investors, stocks with poor earnings were sold due to rising uncertainty over Japan's economic prospects, the official added.
A similar trend is likely to continue in December, the official said. The December figures are not yet available.
